question: Top 5 customers by revenue
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Monthly revenue
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date), ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Revenue by category
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

question: Revenue by country
reference_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.country

question: Orders by status
reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: What is the average order value?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t),2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.id)

question: New customers per month
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date), COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
